diffs.text: Press and hold the Power Button (M2) to summon Divine Light for up to 3s
Divine Light moves away from The Judgment and is controlled with camera controls (left/right only)
While in this state, Divine Light does not damage Survivors
If Divine Light passes through obstacles, it slows down
While controlling Divine Light, press the Attack Button (M1) to Cast it forward
When cast, it enters a brief delay before it fully activates, damaging and applying Heresy to any Survivors hit. (Survivors inflicted with Heresy are known as Heretics)
The longer Divine Light is controlled:
The shorter the Cast delay
The longer the Cast duration
Divine Light has a 6 second cooldown

diffs.text: Press the Secondary Ability Button (LCTRL) to Exile a Heretic in the Dying State, gaining Zealous. (If they have 2 Hook States, they are killed instead.)
Exiling a Survivor gives them a Hook State
When Exiling a Heretic:
The 2 closest Shrines of Judgment become Active
Zealous lasts for 60 seconds
Gain Killer Instinct on all Heretics for 3s. (only applies to Survivors with full Heresy)
While Zealous:
Increase Divine Light's size by 10%
Decrease Divine Light's cooldown by 20%
Maintain control of Divine Light for up to 0.3s (the longer it is controlled before being cast, the lower it will be, starting at 1s)

diffs.text: Exile acts like a Hook, but does not trigger Hook-related perks
Upon entering Exile, Survivors receive a Searcher's Pendant (Limited Item)
Exile is filled with dangerous Seeds of Punishment that reduce a Survivor's Sacrifice timer by 1s when hit
Exile is also filled with helpful Exiled Souls. Hold the Use Item button (M2) to point the Searcher's Pendant at Exiled Souls to collect them
For each Exiled Soul collected (up to 10), Survivors gain an additional 0.5s to default Unhook Protections (10% Haste, Endurance, and Elusive)
Exiled Souls no longer grant additional protections once all Generators are completed
Survivors who aren't in Exile can Pray at an active Shrine of Judgment (highlighted in red) to rescue Exiled Survivors

items: Fixed an issue where music wasn't restarting properly when using the Mori Preview in Menu.
Fixed an issue where Survivor scream could be heard twice when cage by the Dark Lord during 2v8.
Fixed an issue where Survivor would respond with incorrect voice line after being healed.
Fixed an issue where the SFX of a fully infected Survivor would remain after a disconnection during a Custom Game.
Fixed an issue where The Skull Merchant Drone placement was disabled on some elevated structures
Fixed an issue where The Ghost Face could be revealed around walls when less than 30% of his model was in sight.
Fixed an issue where The Ghost Face's "Lean and Stalk" was hindered by a Survivor standing behind Half Cover.
Fixed an issue where The Legion's cooldown animation would play for a brief moment when stunned while in Feral Frenzy.
Fixed an issue where Survivors were missing the ability to use Snap Out of It after canceling Snap Out of It while holding a Morsel.
Fixed an issue where Survivors had an undesired red glow VFX when affected by The Clown's Tattoo's Middle Finger Add-On.
Fixed an issue where The Skull Merchant's Drone was missing during her Mori.
Fixed an issue where the preview of the Bear Trap placement was visible during The Trapper's Mori from the Killer point of view.
Fixed an issue where The Houndmaster's Search marker and the Command prompts would linger when cancelling an interaction.
Fixed an issue where, sometimes, The Dredge would be indefinitely Undetectable from the Killer point of view after teleporting to lockers more than twice.
Fixed an issue where the generator explosion was missing when failing the Special Skill Check from The Slasher's Deputy's Badge Add-on.
Fixed an issue where, sometimes, using the Virulent Bound at the same time as a pallet was being dropped would cause the Survivor to teleport in front of the Killer.
Fixed an issue where the Survivor external icon was missing for the Add-on Acidic Blood of The Xenomorph.
Fixed an issue where The Skull Merchant's Geographical Readout External Icon was unable to be seen after deploying a Drone.
Fixed issues causing Survivor bots to not dodge special attacks toward the intended direction.
Survivor Bots now have a chance to misdodge Special attacks based on how fast they reacted to the attack.
Fixed issues causing Survivor bots to not heal other Survivors.
Survivor Bots are now more brave against Killers that are not moving away from a location.
Fixed an issue causing Survivor Bots to give up their goal too easily when entering the Terror Radius.
Fixed an issue in Nostromos map where players can stand on top of assets
Fixed an issue in Nostromos map where a locker is clipping into a locker
Fixed an issue in The Shattered Square where the Houndmaster's dog cant vault over a window
Fixed an issue in Nostromos map where survivors clips through a door of a locker when entering it
Fixed an issue in Nostromos map where characters can clip through an assets
Fixed an issue in Groaning Storehouse where the coat of Dustin clips through the door of a locker
Fixed an issue in Gideon Meat Plant where the Nurse can't blink through an asset
Fixed an issue in Mother's Dwelling where the Nurse can't blink through an asset
Fixed an issue in Rancid Abattoir where projectiles are blocked by an invisible collision
Fixed an issue in Family Residence where the Nurse could blink inside the hill
Fixed an issue in Grim Pantry where players can stand on top of an invisible collision
Fixed an issue in Dead Sands where an invisible collisions is present on the shack
Fixed an issue in Father Campbell's Chapel where the Nurse can blink on top of the building
Fixed an issue in Toba Landing where killers can't grab downed survivor in a specific location around the space rover
Fixed an issue where The Skull Merchant Drone placement was disabled on some elevated structures.
Fixed an issue where Visionary Perk doesn't show Aura when exiting a Locker, after the cooldown is completed
Fixed an issue where the Heal progress bar would remain grey while healing another Survivor with the Perk "Do No Harm" active.
Fixed an issue where the Perk Icon of Lucky Star would appear with the Red Cooldown Effect at the start of a Trial.
Fixed an issue where the Saboteur Perk would go on cooldown when a Survivor sabotaged a Hook with a Toolbox containing 6 charges.
Fixed an issue where the Scene Partner Perk would activate while looking away from the Killer when the cooldown finished while within two Terror Radiuses.

Fixed an issue where all Tokens would be consumed when 2 Survivors with the "Corrective Action" Perk equipped each had only 1 Token and a Survivor without the "Corrective Action" Perk failed a skill check.
Fixed an issue where the Perk A Nurse's Calling would not reveal the Aura of a Survivor that was healing.
The Players Tab in Match Details now shows the Killer's Portrait instead of their Power Icon
It is a known issue that a handful of Legendary cosmetics to not have a Killer Portrait icon. This will be fixed in an upcoming release.
Fixed an issue where the game would freeze for a bit when hovering over the quest button.
Fixed an issue where changing the fullscreen mode would not update mouse capture settings immediately.
Fixed an issue where Survivors were unable to create a Beam of Light after charging the map, dropping and picking it back up.
Fixed an issue where XESS Mode was unable to be applied with TAA enabled.
